name: Navbar
description: Comprehensive navigation bar with logo, nested menus, authentication, responsive design, and theming support
author: JasonJS Framework

parameters.name: logo
parameters.description: Logo image URL or custom React element

parameters.name: logoText
parameters.description: Text to display next to or instead of logo

parameters.name: navigation
parameters.description: Array of navigation items with optional submenus. NavItem: { name: string, href: string, target?: string, submenu?: Array<{name: string, href: string}> }

parameters.name: showAuth
parameters.description: Show authentication buttons (Sign In/Sign Up or Profile/Sign Out)

parameters.name: profileMode
parameters.description: Profile experience mode: modal (default) opens profile in overlay, redirect navigates to profile page

parameters.name: profileHref
parameters.description: Profile page URL (used when profileMode is 'redirect')

parameters.name: afterSignOutUrl
parameters.description: URL to redirect after sign out

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Visual style variant: default (solid), gradient (colorful), or glass (glassmorphism)

parameters.name: transparent
parameters.description: Make background transparent (useful for hero sections)

useCases: E-commerce store navigation with product categories
SaaS application header with user profile
Marketing landing page with transparent header
Blog or content site with nested menu structure
